copy.heading: Communication
copy.subheading: Talking about something that is not your round, and listening to the answer.
body: The most common complaint the Programme receives concerns conversation. Households report that a returning golfer can turn any question, from "Did you pick up the milk?" to "How's your mum?", into a hole-by-hole account of the morning. This stage will teach you to hear a question, answer it, and ask one back.

illustration.concept: Dave at the family tea table mid-story, using a knife and fork to show the line of a putt across his plate, while Sue and the two small children stare at him and their fish fingers go cold.
